description: Public launch ramps, hoists and beach launches a trip can start from, one list per region. Positions are the facility positions listed by the source, good for choosing a launch and estimating run distance to a spot; they are never navigation waypoints, and `departure` is an approximate open-water position outside the harbor used only for distance estimates.

dbw.name: California State Parks, Division of Boating and Waterways: Boating Facilities database
dbw.note: State facility records (name, address, listed position, operator, trailer parking, floats, services as far as the schema names them). Confirm hours, fees and conditions with the operator before a trip.

launch_points.name: Morro Bay Public Launch Facility

departure.note: Approximate open water south-west of the Morro Bay breakwater heads; recheck the actual entrance and bar at departure and return.

launch_points.note: At Tidelands Park, south end of the Embarcadero. The URL is the harbor department's current page; the state record links an older address.

launch_points.name: Port San Luis Boat Launch Facility
launch_points.address: 3950 Avila Beach Dr, Avila Beach, CA 93424

departure.note: Open water south-east of the Port San Luis breakwater.

launch_points.note: The harbor district also hoist-launches from Harford Pier; ask it for weight and size limits.

launch_points.name: Olde Port Beach
launch_points.address: 6520 Avila Beach Dr, Avila Beach, CA 93405

departure.note: Open water south-east of the Port San Luis breakwater.

launch_points.note: Beach launch for small trailered boats; conditions and access change, so check with the harbor district first. Address and ZIP as listed by the state record.
